snippet.description:

BIG NEWS!! We're thrilled to announce that Kingmakers will release in Early Access on October 8th 2025!

This is your call to arms—rally your co-op comrades, ready your strategies, and mark your calendars. 

The timeline is cracking. Wishlist Kingmakers and get ready to reshape history.
